description.fun: A copper elephant calf strong enough to carry loads of over five tons without any trouble. Each morning it heads into the caves with its herd, carving off chunks of ore to eat with the pointed tip of its trunk. Rain tarnishes its copper skin a vibrant green. Docile and hard-working, Cufant was brought to Galar and Paldea to help people with heavy labour.
description.guide: A Steel-type elephant Pokémon whose skin contains copper, used for heavy labour in Galar and Paldea. Cufant evolves into Copperajah.
description.tagline: A copper elephant calf built for heavy lifting

description.fun: Brought from a faraway land long ago to work with people, Copperajah is strong enough to pull an aeroplane, and its trunk can crush boulders into powder. The more vibrant its rain-tarnished green skin, the prouder it is, and the more respect it gets from its herd. Raichu's older Pokédex entries talked about knocking out an Indian elephant; in Legends: Arceus, that became a Copperajah.
description.guide: The evolution of Cufant, a large Steel-type elephant Pokémon based on the Indian elephant. Its copper skin tarnishes green in the rain. It has a Gigantamax form.
description.tagline: A proud copper elephant that can pull an aeroplane

description.fun: It rears up on its hind legs, its body turns blocky and its trunk grows serrated ridges. That trunk can now level mountains and demolish large buildings in a single smashing blow.
